pin_configuration: Pin 1: Vref (+5.0V) | Pin 2: Signal TPS | Pin 3: Sensor Ground (E2)
testing_notes: Tegangan harus naik secara linier tanpa putus saat katup dibuka perlahan.

pin_configuration: Pin 1: Power 12V (IG) | Pin 2: Signal Output (5V Square Wave) | Pin 3: Ground
voltage_idle: Pulsa gelombang kotak 0V - 5.0V mengikuti putaran mesin
resistance_ohm: Tipe Hall Effect: Jangan ukur dengan Ohmmeter biasa; gunakan osiloskop/multimeter DCV.
testing_notes: Panaskan area sensor dengan heatgun (~80°C) jika menguji gejala mati saat mesin panas.

pin_configuration: Pin 1: Ground (E2) | Pin 2: IAT Signal | Pin 3: VC (+5.0V) | Pin 4: PIM (MAP Signal)
voltage_wot: 3.80 - 4.20 V (Kunci Kontak ON Mesin Mati / Atmosferik ~101 kPa)
resistance_ohm: Ukur berbasis output voltase pada Pin 4 terhadap Ground E2
testing_notes: Jika pembacaan kPa tidak berubah saat digas, periksa selang/lubang port vakum dari sumbatan oli.

pin_configuration: 2 Kabel Hitam: Heater (12V & Duty ECM) | 1 Biru/Hitam: Signal (+) | 1 Putih/Abu: Ground (-)
voltage_idle: Berfluktuasi cepat antara 0.10 V (Lean) hingga 0.90 V (Rich) pada suhu kerja > 350°C
voltage_wot: 0.80 - 0.92 V (Saat akselerasi penuh / Open Loop Enrichment)
resistance_ohm: Rangkaian Heater: 4.0 - 15.0 Ohm pada suhu ruang 25°C
testing_notes: Jika tegangan tertahan konstan di 0.45V setelah mesin panas, sensor O2 sudah mati/tidak aktif.

sensor_name: Electric Throttle Body - TPS Main & Sub (Bab 1A Hal. 261-262)
pin_configuration: C37-53 (WHT): +5V Power Source | C37-54 (BLK): TPS Main Signal | C37-40 (RED): TPS Sub Signal | C37-41 (GRN): TPS Ground | C37-44 (BLU/RED) & C37-45 (BLU/YEL): Throttle Actuator Motor Drive
voltage_idle: TPS Main (C37-54): 0.72 - 1.04 V | TPS Sub (C37-40): 1.60 - 1.91 V (Pedal gas posisi idle)
voltage_wot: TPS Main (C37-54): 3.67 - 4.25 V | TPS Sub (C37-40): 3.88 - 4.45 V (Pedal gas ditekan penuh)
resistance_ohm: Ground C37-41 (GRN) ke massa mesin: < 3 Ohm | Supply C37-53 (WHT): 4.5 - 5.5 V
testing_notes: Jika DTC P0122 dan P0222 muncul bersamaan, periksa kabel WHT (C37-53) +5V kemungkinan putus. Tegangan diukur setelah mesin dipanaskan dengan kunci kontak ON.

sensor_name: Accelerator Pedal Position (APP) Sensor Main & Sub (Bab 1A Hal. 265)
pin_configuration: E23-56 (WHT): +5V APP Main | E23-55 (WHT/BLU): APP Main Signal | E23-54 (ORN): Ground APP Main | E23-53 (ORN/BLU): +5V APP Sub | E23-52 (BLU/GRN): APP Sub Signal | E23-51 (BLU/YEL): Ground APP Sub
voltage_idle: APP Main (E23-55): 0.65 - 0.82 V | APP Sub (E23-52): 0.30 - 0.44 V (Pedal gas bebas/idle)
voltage_wot: APP Main (E23-55): 3.50 - 4.27 V | APP Sub (E23-52): 1.74 - 2.17 V (Pedal gas injak penuh)
resistance_ohm: Ground E23-54 (ORN) & E23-51 (BLU/YEL): < 0.3 V saat kunci kontak ON
testing_notes: Pastikan sumber +5V pada E23-56 (WHT) dan E23-53 (ORN/BLU) berada di rentang 4.5 - 5.5 V.

sensor_name: Mass Air Flow (MAF) & Intake Air Temp (IAT) Sensor (Bab 1A Hal. 260)
pin_configuration: Power Supply: BLU/BLK (10-14V) | C37-26 (RED): MAF Signal | C37-27 (BLU): MAF Ground | C37-25 (LT GRN): IAT Signal | C37-57 (GRY/GRN): Sensor Ground
voltage_idle: MAF (C37-26): 0.5 - 1.0 V (Kunci ON mesin mati) | 1.3 - 1.8 V (Mesin hidup putaran idle hangat)
resistance_ohm: Ground MAF C37-27 (BLU) & Ground Sensor C37-57 (GRY/GRN) ke bodi: < 3 Ohm
testing_notes: Tegangan power supply kabel BLU/BLK pada konektor MAF harus 10 - 14 V saat kunci kontak ON.

sensor_name: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) & Engine Coolant Temp (ECT) (Bab 1A Hal. 258-262)
pin_configuration: C37-14 (GRY/RED): +5V Supply MAP | C37-55 (RED/WHT): MAP Signal | C37-24 (PPL/YEL): ECT Signal | C37-57 (GRY/GRN): Sensor Ground
voltage_idle: MAP (C37-55): 0.4 - 2.0 V saat idle hangat (Sekitar 4.0 V saat Kunci ON mesin mati @ 100 kPa)
resistance_ohm: Supply 5V C37-14 (GRY/RED): 4.5 - 5.5 V (dibagi dengan A/C pressure & electric load sensor)
testing_notes: Catatan Bab 1A Hal. 199: Jika DTC P0107 dan P1501 muncul bersamaan, periksa kabel GRY/RED (C37-14) putus. Jika DTC P0108, P0113, dan P0118 muncul bersamaan, periksa ground sensor GRY/GRN (C37-57).

sensor_name: CKP Sensor, CMP Sensor, A/F Sensor (Sensor-1) & HO2S-2 (Bab 1A Hal. 258-262)
pin_configuration: CKP: C37-51 (BLU/GRN +) & C37-36 (PNK -) | CMP: C37-52 (WHT/RED) | A/F Sensor-1: C37-38 (WHT +), C37-37 (BLK -), C37-32 (PNK/BLU Heater) | HO2S-2: C37-11 (RED Signal), C37-47 (BLK/RED Heater)
voltage_idle: A/F Sensor-1: C37-38 (WHT) 3.0 - 3.2 V & C37-37 (BLK) 2.6 - 2.8 V saat idle | HO2S-2 (C37-11): ~0.15 V saat idle (4 - 5 V saat Kunci ON)
voltage_wot: CKP (C37-51 & C37-36): Gelombang sinusoidal +4..+6V ke -4..-6V (30 [36-6] pulsa/putaran kruk as) | CMP (C37-52): Pulsa 0-0.6V <-> 4-5V (6 pulsa/putaran camshaft)
resistance_ohm: Ground HO2S-2 (GRN) ke massa mesin: < 3 Ohm
testing_notes: Gunakan oscilloscope untuk memeriksa gelombang CKP (CH1 C37-51) dan CMP (CH1 C37-52).
